notes: TMR Queensland design sheet (Q-series book / TC-series), colour drawing 'not to scale' with a lettered dimension table; every dimension from the sheet, AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheets give no letter widths, so there is no width check. Q-series sheet W5-Q16 'Overhead wires' warning sign (2014/2023; used with the W8-Q17 clearance plate or the W8-Q16 BOATS LOWER MASTS plate per the notes and examples). Size A 600 diamond generated (B 750 also tabled): a 600 side drawn as the bounding square 848.53, r 40, b 10 yellow edge + c 20 black border (separate spans on the sheet). Vertical chain on the sheet, read about the horizontal centreline and checked against the drawn text (PDF spans: Series C, OVERHEAD baseline 21.5 below centre, WIRES cap top 73 below centre, at the drawing's 1.14 scale): bolt f 240 tall ending e 105 above the centreline (bolt box y 79.27-319.27, 100 wide as drawn 103 x 247, centred), OVERHEAD g 100C with its baseline d 20 below the centreline (cap top 344.27), WIRES g 100C with its cap top h 80 below the centreline (504.27); the drawn OVERHEAD-WIRES gap is 45 at the sheet's scale for the 60 the chain gives, the chain is used. The bolt is the sheet's own vector path (tools/symbols/qld_w5-q16_bolt.svg, vec2sym2, not traced). Black on retroreflective yellow.
